mechanism: Quetiapine may increase tretinoin levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, and both agents can elevate intracranial pressure and CNS effects; tretinoin increases photosensitivity risk which may be compounded by quetiapine's dermatologic effects.
action: Monitor for tretinoin toxicity signs (headache, visual changes, increased intracranial pressure); use sunscreen vigilantly; consider baseline and periodic ophthalmologic evaluation.
